description: The next public holiday strictly after a date (default: today) for uk, us, de, fr, with its name, date, weekday and days until it, the three that follow, and any holiday falling on the date itself; by region as for calendar_facts (UK nations, US federal with OPM's observed date deciding the order, German Länder, French zones). The data runs to the end of 2028; a later date answers covered:false with the last date covered. From the same monthly snapshot of the official lists, with the list's URL as source.

country.description: one of uk, us, de, fr, or a name

from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; the next holiday is the first one after this day (default: today)

region.description: as for calendar_facts (default: england-and-wales, federal, nationwide, metropole)

name: next_holiday
title: Next public holiday
